name: BaDoinkVR
summary: Pioneering VR studio network combining polished POV camera ergonomics, interactive toy scripts, and multi-brand passes (BabeVR, VRCosplayX, KinkVR).
ranking_rationale: Long-standing VR standard-setter with standout multi-site variety (including VRCosplayX), comfortable POV camera height, and broad headset compatibility.

pricing.notes: Varies by plan and promo; bundle passes unlock sister VR lines like VRCosplayX and BabeVR. Check official checkout.

platforms: Meta Quest / PCVR / Vision Pro web
pros: Multi-site network covers mainstream, cosplay (VRCosplayX), and kink VR
Well-calibrated POV camera angles reduce VR eye strain
Supports interactive haptic toy scripts across hundreds of scenes
Works smoothly across Meta Quest, PCVR, and downloadable formats
cons: Full network bundle costs more than single-site plans
Older 2015–2017 archive scenes show lower early-VR resolution
No substantial free library beyond trailers

facts.value: Paid membership subscription (single site or multi-VR bundle)
Sister brands like VRCosplayX and KinkVR plus interactive toy scripts
